simple.summary: גְּדֵרֹתַיִם (Gᵉdêrôthayim) means Gederothajim , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 36.

definitions.full: H1453. Gederothayim גְּדֵרֹתָ֫יִם proper name, of a location in Judah Josh 15:36 ; perhaps strike out, so ᵐ5 ; whole number too large, compare Di.
